subject.title: [codex] fix launchd restart when gateway port is busy

question: Should this PR land the narrow launchd restart change that lets kickstart proceed while the managed gateway still owns the port, or should it wait for a broader restart/update handoff design?
rationale: The code change is small and source-backed, but it intentionally changes an availability-sensitive fail-closed precondition in the macOS managed gateway restart path.

options.title: Land the scoped launchd fix
options.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers accept launchd-owned replacement semantics and keep the broader related trackers open.

options.title: Request direct-caller health proof
options.body: Ask for additional proof that configure, doctor, setup, and update callers surface failed post-kickstart health correctly before merge.

options.title: Pause for unified restart semantics
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want busy-port handling, SIGTERM intent ordering, and update handoff semantics solved together.

recommendation.title: Land the scoped launchd fix
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers accept launchd-owned replacement semantics and keep the broader related trackers open.
